[[Category:Senate Motion]][[Category:386YE Autumn]]
__NOTOC__
<quote by="Announced by Protectorate Thenrik, Legion Engineer">To commission the building of a Bounders Hall in Meade. This will create a Marcher National title of the "Bailiff of Meade" appointed by Marcher senators. This was funded by the prosperous house of Talbot and the House Mudd, both of Mitwold.</quote>
==Overview==
* Constructs a Bounder's Hall in [[Mitwold]] as per the '''[[Kith_and_kin#Hard_Work|Kith and kin]]''' wind of fortune
* Announcement by the [[Legion Engineer]]
==Date==
* Autumn 386YE
==Cost==
* Costs as per opportunity
* 12 white granite
* 36 crowns
* Three months to complete
==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|Bounders_Hall_of_Meade}}
==Outcome==
* Now complete, the position of [[Bailiff of Meade]] will be available to appoint by unanimous vote of the senators of [[the Marches]] for the first time at the Winter Solstice 386YE. Marcher [[beater|beaters]] can now send their [[military unit|military units]] to defend Mitwold.
